title: Hollow and Thorn
author: Noor Eastwick
blurb: Mara Brightwater, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
